from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u050/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the non-uniform, contiguous color key line.
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for c in range(w)]
        nz = [c for c,v in enumerate(vals) if v]
        if len(nz) >= 2 and nz == list(range(nz[0], nz[-1]+1)) and len(set(vals[nz[0]:nz[-1]+1])) > 1:
            candidates.append((len(nz), vals[nz[0]:nz[-1]+1], 'row'))
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        nz = [r for r,v in enumerate(vals) if v]
        if len(nz) >= 2 and nz == list(range(nz[0], nz[-1]+1)) and len(set(vals[nz[0]:nz[-1]+1])) > 1:
            candidates.append((len(nz), vals[nz[0]:nz[-1]+1], 'col'))
    _, palette, _ = max(candidates)
    # The color-1 drawing is the template; place one copy for each key color.
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    mask = [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    idx = palette.index(1)
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i, color in enumerate(palette):
        top = r0 + (i-idx)*(r1-r0+1)
        for dr,dc in mask:
            rr,cc = top+dr,c0+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-3b0d5501.py'; p.write_text(code)
